name: windows-control
description: Workspace-linking manifest only: this plugin's server/connect entrypoints are plain JS loaded at runtime via dynamic import() (see apps/server/src/plugins/loader.ts and apps/connect/src/plugins/loader.ts), not built through this package.json. It exists so `pnpm install` links @streamdesk/interface-sdk and @streamdesk/ui-kit here for interface/index.tsx's imports to resolve when apps/interface type-checks it (see apps/interface/tsconfig.json).
